title: Complete Light Theme Transformation with Premium Banarasi Aesthetics

requirements.text: Replace all dark theme colors (navy blue, black backgrounds) throughout the entire application with a premium light theme palette: soft warm ivory/pearl cream (#F8F5F0) for primary backgrounds, very light beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6) for secondary backgrounds/sections, antique gold/warm gold (#C9A96E or #D4B37D) for primary accents representing zari/gold shine, muted blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) for secondary accents, deep charcoal gray (#1A1A1A) for primary text ensuring perfect readability, warm taupe gray (#5C4B51) for secondary/muted text, antique gold background (#C9A96E) with dark text (#1A1A1A) for buttons/CTAs with hover effects (deeper gold + scale + glow), pure white (#FFFFFF) cards/product tiles with subtle 1px gold border (#C9A96E) and soft shadow, and warm gold box-shadow (0 0 18px rgba(201,169,110,0.45)) for hover/active glow effects

quotes: Completely remove all dark themes (no navy blue, no black backgrounds)
Background primary: soft warm ivory / pearl cream #F8F5F0
Primary accent (zari / gold shine): antique gold / warm gold #C9A96E or #D4B37D

acceptanceCriteria: No navy blue or black backgrounds visible anywhere in the application
All backgrounds use ivory (#F8F5F0) or beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6)
Primary text is deep charcoal gray (#1A1A1A) with excellent contrast
All buttons use antique gold background (#C9A96E) with dark text
Product cards are pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold borders
Hover effects show warm gold glow (box-shadow with rgba(201,169,110,0.45))

requirements.text: Update typography throughout the application to use premium luxury fonts: Playfair Display ExtraBold for all headings and brand name 'DoRaa Sangam House' with antique gold color (#C9A96E) and letter-spacing of 2-4px, Great Vibes Regular script font for category names and special titles (like 'Zari Royalty') with blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) or antique gold (#C9A96E) color at size 2.8-3.8rem, Lora Regular 400 for all body text and descriptions with deep charcoal color (#1A1A1A) and line-height 1.9-2.1, and Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold for buttons/CTAs in all caps with dark text on gold background

quotes: Headings / brand name: Playfair Display ExtraBold, color #C9A96E, letter-spacing 2–4px
Category names / special titles: Great Vibes Regular (script), color #E8C0C8 or #C9A96E, size 2.8–3.8rem
Body text / descriptions: Lora Regular 400, color #1A1A1A, line-height 1.9–2.1
Buttons / CTAs: Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold, all caps, dark text on gold bg

acceptanceCriteria: All headings and 'DoRaa Sangam House' brand name use Playfair Display ExtraBold in antique gold
Category names use Great Vibes script font at 2.8-3.8rem size
All body text uses Lora Regular with line-height 1.9-2.1
All buttons use Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold in all caps
Letter-spacing on headings is 2-4px
Typography renders consistently on all devices

requirements.text: Implement Vastrado-style home page layout after login with: large DoRaa Sangam House logo (gold luxury version) centered at the top, horizontal category navigation bar below the logo displaying categories (Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All) that is scrollable on mobile, user profile/dashboard icon positioned on the right side, below navigation display a grid of saree/product cards showing on-model images with product name, price, discount badge, and 'Add to Cart' button, cards styled with curved corners, white background, and gold hover border with lift effect

quotes: Center top: large DoRaa Sangam House logo (gold luxury version)
Below logo: horizontal category navigation bar (scrollable on mobile): Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All
Below nav: grid of saree/product cards

acceptanceCriteria: Logo is centered at top in gold luxury styling
Horizontal category bar displays all specified categories
Category navigation scrolls smoothly on mobile
Profile/dashboard icon is visible on the right
Product grid displays below navigation
Product cards show image, name, price, discount badge, and Add to Cart button
Cards have curved corners, white background, and lift on hover
Gold border appears on card hover

requirements.text: Update dashboard (accessed via profile icon click) to include: tabs for Profile, Orders, and Addresses, add an 'Appearance' section with theme switcher buttons showing Light (default and only active option), with Dark and System options disabled or hidden since only light theme is required, user details section displaying name, email, phone with 'Save Changes' button

quotes: Add 'Appearance' section with theme switcher buttons
User details (name, email, phone, Save Changes)

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard has Profile, Orders, and Addresses tabs
Appearance section is visible with theme switcher
Light theme option is active and selected by default
Dark and System options are disabled or hidden
User details form shows name, email, and phone fields
Save Changes button is present and functional

requirements.text: Ensure 100% consistent appearance across laptop, mobile, and tablet devices with no media-query overrides for colors, fonts, or backgrounds, using rem units and clamp() for responsive scaling, ensuring all premium hover animations (glow, lift, scale) are smooth and work across devices while respecting reduced motion preferences

quotes: Theme must look identical on laptop, mobile, tablet (no media-query overrides for colors/fonts/background)
Use rem units, clamp() for responsive scaling

acceptanceCriteria: Colors, fonts, and backgrounds are identical on laptop, mobile, and tablet
No media queries override the light theme colors or typography
All spacing uses rem units
Font sizes use clamp() for fluid responsive scaling
Hover animations work smoothly with warm gold glow and lift effects
Reduced motion preferences are respected
No responsiveness issues or layout breaks on any device

requirements.text: Update CSS variables in frontend/index.css and Tailwind configuration in frontend/tailwind.config.js to reflect the new light theme color palette, ensuring all component styles reference these new variables consistently
acceptanceCriteria: CSS variables updated with ivory, antique gold, rose gold, and charcoal values
Tailwind config includes new color palette
All components use the updated CSS variables
Theme system no longer references dark/navy blue colors

constraints: Do not modify backend/main.mo, backend/migration.mo, or any backend logic

Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing functionality: login/OTP, cart, category carousel, checkout, orders
Keep React, Tailwind, Shadcn, and React Query as the frontend stack
nonGoals: Adding new backend features or data models
Implementing new authentication methods beyond existing Internet Identity and OTP
Adding new product categories beyond those specified

required: Gold luxury version of DoRaa Sangam House logo with antique gold coloring and premium Banarasi aesthetic suitable for center header placement (doraa-logo-gold.dim_400x120.png)
